title: Queen of the Black Coast
summary: "Queen of the Black Coast" by Robert E. Howard is a short story first published in May 1934. Together they plunder coastal villages and raid merchant ships, forging a legendary partnership built on both violence and romance. When they venture up a mysterious river and discover ancient ruins filled with treasure, they encounter supernatural horrors that will test Bêlit's promise that not even death could separate them.
